DIRECTION A — MODERN
One floating glass surface over an edge-to-edge frame. Chrome fades at 2.4 s and the picture is never permanently cropped by UI. Everything the user sets rarely lives in one overlay panel; everything they touch constantly sits in the bar.
Best at: fullscreen viewing, single-file playback, looking like nothing else.

RESPONSIVE & STATES
Same window, same wgpu surface, different widget tree below 1100 px. Mini player, touch layout, the no-file state and the clip/record mode — the four screens that decide whether the player feels finished or like a demo.

DIRECTION B — CLASSIC
The VLC / MPC-HC lineage, done carefully. Menu bar, docked strip, live status readout, dockable playlist. Nothing overlays the picture and nothing disappears, so muscle memory and the keyboard both work.
Best at: libraries and queues, auditing files, users who already know a player.
